rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for writing ink and for referring to a particular ink type or colour.

example.jyutping: ni1 zi1 mak6 seoi2 hai6 laam4 sik1 ge3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the dark fluid released by squid or cuttlefish.

example.english: Squid ink mixed with rice tastes great.
example.jyutping: mak6 jyu4 zap1 lou1 faan6 sik6 hou2 hoeng1

rows.note: Use this only when the sense is the bottle or container holding ink.

example.english: The ink bottle is leaking ink all over the desk.
example.traditional: 支墨水樽漏墨水，搞到成枱都係。
example.jyutping: zi1 mak6 seoi2 zeon1 lau6 mak6 seoi2 gaau2 dou3 seng4 toi2 dou1 hai6
